@Alyssa_Milano @realDonaldTrump I was first repeatedly sexually assaulted at age 7. Couldn't tell anyone. As adults, my sister shared that she was assaulted by the same man. When we told our parents, my mom cried. My dad didn't believe us. I still have nightmares from it. 50+ years later. 
#metoo

@TheChickLivesOn Sorta right. Any girl who experiences sexual assault doesn't have to get pregnant as a result thereof.  The assault is enough to scar her for life. I'm speaking from experience. 
#MeToo

@kurteichenwald Sharing such trauma can be both cathartic and traumatic.  My heart breaks for you and the pain you've experienced through the years. I hope you find healing in the telling and in knowing you are not alone. I have, but it's still a journey no one should have to travel. ❤
#MeToo

@SenGillibrand Thank you. I have a lump in my throat and tears in my eyes at your kind and true words. It's been 50+ years for me. And still nobody listens. But I fight on. And on. And on.
#MeToo
